# RenderLogic

> RenderLogic is a Kerala creative studio and software lab led by Achu Vijayan. It combines film post-production with private, offline-first AI software.

## Primary pages
- Home: https://www.renderlogic.in/
- Film editing, color grading, and AI filmmaking: https://www.renderlogic.in/film-making/
- Offline AI Software Lab: https://www.renderlogic.in/software-lab/
- Lipi offline voice intelligence: https://www.heylipi.com/
- Achu Vijayan and RenderLogic: https://www.renderlogic.in/about/
- Contact: https://www.renderlogic.in/contact/
- Articles: https://www.renderlogic.in/blog/

## Film work
RenderLogic provides theatrical film editing, DaVinci Resolve color grading, directing, VFX, and AI-assisted filmmaking workflows. Portfolio credits represented on the site include House For Sale (2027), Boom Bang (2026), Aaram (2026), Vichithram, Charles Enterprises, Aattam, Mukundan Unni Associates, Oru Adaar Love, Thuninthavan / Orumbettavan, Simba, White, and Second Show.

## Software
RenderLogic builds local-first applications and creator utilities. Lipi (formerly Parayu) is private offline AI voice intelligence with system-wide voice typing, cross-language speech translation across 99+ spoken languages, on-device chat, and file transcription. Product downloads and details are available at https://www.heylipi.com/.
